title: Maintained-Vehicle Allowance for Kessler Care Plan Holders — Service Accounts and Repair Orders
content:
On a Service Accounts and Repair Orders repeat repair estimate, the maintained-vehicle allowance follows the vehicle's Kessler Care plan, as the Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans records show, and the miles since the earlier repair:
- where the vehicle carries an active Kessler Care maintenance plan and has been driven more than 15000 miles since the earlier repair, the labor amount is multiplied by 0.88;
- where it carries an active plan and has been driven no more than 15000 miles since, by 0.8;
- otherwise it is not reduced.

The vehicle is the one on the latest diagnostic fee; the miles since are the odometer on that fee less the earlier repair's odometer at check-in.

| Active Kessler Care plan on the vehicle | Miles since the earlier repair | Multiplied by |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | More than 15000 | 0.88 |
| Yes | 15000 or fewer | 0.8 |
| No | Any | not reduced |
